source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 10 (PDF 229-250), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electromagnetism) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is electromagnetism? Name two areas of modern technology that depend on it.
(Electromagnetism kya hai? Jadeed technology ke do shobe batayein jo is par munhasir hain.)
blocks.explanation: Electromagnetism physics ka woh hissa hai jo parhta hai ke electric charges aur magnetic fields aapas mein kaise asar karte hain. Phones, computers aur medical devices jaisi technology is par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Electromagnetism is a key area of physics that studies how electric charges and magnetic fields interact.

blocks.prompt:
2 What did Oersted discover in 1820? What is the converse effect?
(Oersted ne 1820 mein kya dariyaft kiya? Is ka ulat asar kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1820 mein Hans Christian Oersted ne maloom kiya ke electricity aur magnetism jure hue hain: current wale conductor ke gird magnetic field banta hai. Ulat tor par, badalta magnetic field us mein rakhe conductor mein current paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: In 1820, Hans Christian Orsted found that electricity and magnetism are correlated.

blocks.prompt:
3 What is lodestone and why is it important in the history of magnetism?
(Lodestone kya hai aur magnetism ki tareekh mein yeh kyun aham hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lodestone yani magnetite (Fe₃O₄) aik qudrati mineral hai jis se magnetism ki shuruat hui. Yeh iron aur steel ko kheenchta hai aur Earth ke magnetic poles ki seedh mein aata hai; is se compass ijaad hua.

book_ref.quote: Magnetism started with lodestone, a natural mineral discovered in ancient

blocks.text: 10.1 Force on a current-carrying conductor in a uniform magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
4 Why does a current-carrying conductor placed in a magnetic field experience a force?
(Magnetic field mein rakhe current wale conductor par force kyun lagti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jaise do magnets apne fields ke zariye aik doosre par force lagate hain, waise hi conductor ka apna magnetic field (current ki wajah se) bahar ke magnetic field se asar karta hai. Is asar se conductor par force lagti hai.

book_ref.quote: a current-carrying conductor experiences a force due to the interaction between its own magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
5 In Fig. 10.2 the conductor moves to the left. Explain why.
(Fig. 10.2 mein conductor baayen taraf kyun harkat karta hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Current ka field aur bahar ka uniform field daayen taraf aik doosre ko taaqat dete hain aur baayen taraf kaat dete hain. Conductor kamzor field wali taraf jata hai, is liye force baayen taraf hai.

book_ref.quote: reinforce each other on the right side of the conductor and cancel each other on the left side

blocks.prompt:
6 State Fleming's left-hand rule.
(Fleming ka left-hand rule bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Baayan haath aise rakhein ke pehli ungli magnetic field ki simt mein aur doosri ungli current ki simt mein ho; angootha conductor par force ki simt batayega.

book_ref.quote: Position your left hand such that the first finger points in the direction of magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
7 State the right hand rule for the direction of force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field.
(Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force ki simt ke liye right hand rule bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Daayen haath ki ungliyan chhote angle se current se magnetic field ki taraf morein; seedha angootha force ki simt batata hai.

book_ref.quote: the stretched thumb will indicate the direction of force

blocks.prompt:
8 Define magnetic field strength (magnetic induction) and give its SI unit.
(Magnetic field strength (magnetic induction) ki definition aur SI unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: B = F/IL se magnetic field strength adadi tor par us force ke barabar hai jo field par amoodi 1 A current wale 1 m lambe conductor par lagti hai. SI unit tesla (T); 1 T = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹. Yeh field ki simt mein vector hai.

book_ref.quote: The magnetic strength is numerically equal to the force exerted on a conductor of length one metre

blocks.prompt:
9 When is the force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field (i) maximum (ii) zero?
(Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force kab (i) sab se zyada (ii) sifar hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = BIL sin θ se: (i) jab conductor field par amoodi ho (θ = 90°) to force sab se zyada, BIL; (ii) jab conductor field ki seedh mein ho (θ = 0) to force sifar.

book_ref.quote: Equation (10.2) shows that the force will be maximum (BIL)

blocks.prompt:
10 A 25 cm wire carrying 8 A makes an angle of 60° with a uniform magnetic field of 0.15 T. Find the force on it.
(8 A current wali 25 cm taar 0.15 T ke uniform magnetic field se 60° ka angle banati hai. Us par force nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Now consider a conductor L placed at an angle

blocks.prompt:
11 A 50 cm conductor placed at right angles to a 0.6 T field experiences a force of 0.9 N. Find the current in it.
(0.6 T field par amoodi 50 cm conductor par 0.9 N force lagti hai. Us mein current nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: F = BIL, is liye I = F/BL = 0.9/(0.6 × 0.50) = 3 A.

book_ref.quote: Experimentally, it has been observed that the magnitude of the force acting on the conductor

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between Fleming's left-hand rule and the right hand rule for the force on a conductor.
(Conductor par force ke liye Fleming ke left-hand rule aur right hand rule mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono force ki simt batate hain; haath aur ungliyon ki tarteeb mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: However direction of force can also be found by using right hand rule

rows: Pehli ungli field ki taraf, doosri ungli current ki taraf.
Ungliyan chhote angle se current se field ki taraf mori jaati hain.

blocks.prompt:
13 Write the vector form of the force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field. What is the vector L?
(Magnetic field mein current wale conductor par force ki vector shakal likhein. Vector L kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = I L × B (Eq. 10.3). L aisa vector hai jis ki magnitude conductor ki lambai aur simt current ke bahao ki taraf hai. Is ki magnitude F = BIL sin θ deti hai.

book_ref.quote: We can also consider a vector L which has a magnitude equal to the length of the conductor

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the Earth's magnetic field as given in the chapter.
(Chapter ke mutabiq Earth ke magnetic field ko bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Earth ka magnetic field taqreeban aik dipole jaisa hai, jaise andar aik farzi bar magnet ho. Is ka south magnetic pole geographic north pole ki taraf aur north magnetic pole geographic south pole ki taraf hai.

book_ref.quote: like that of the fictitious bar magnet

blocks.prompt:
15 Define magnetic flux. Is it a scalar or a vector? Give a reason.
(Magnetic flux ki definition likhein. Yeh scalar hai ya vector? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Uniform field B mein plane area A se magnetic flux dot product hai: ϕ_B = B · A = BA cos θ. Yeh scalar hai, kyunke do vectors ka dot product scalar hota hai. Unit: weber (Wb).

book_ref.quote: Equation (10.6) shows that

blocks.prompt:
16 What is meant by vector area? What is θ in ϕ_B = BA cos θ?
(Vector area se kya muraad hai? ϕ_B = BA cos θ mein θ kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vector area A ki magnitude element ka area hai aur simt us ki surface ke normal (amood) ki taraf. θ, B aur A ka angle hai, yani field aur surface ke normal ka angle.

book_ref.quote: Note that A is a vector whose magnitude is the area of the element

blocks.prompt:
17 When is the magnetic flux through a plane area (i) maximum (ii) zero?
(Plane area se magnetic flux kab (i) sab se zyada (ii) sifar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Jab field area ke normal ki seedh mein ho (θ = 0°) to flux sab se zyada, ϕ = BA. (ii) Jab field area ke plane ke mutawazi ho (θ = 90°) to flux sifar.

book_ref.quote: so θ is zero (cos0° = 1) and the flux is maximum, equal to BA

blocks.prompt:
18 How is the magnetic flux through a curved surface found?
(Curved surface se magnetic flux kaise nikala jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Curved surface ko bohat se chhote elements mein baanta jata hai, har aik ko plane maana jata hai. Har element ka flux BA cos θ nikal kar sab ko jama kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: In case of a curved surface placed in a uniform magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
19 Define weber and express it in terms of N, m and A.
(Weber ki definition likhein aur isay N, m aur A ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Weber magnetic flux ki SI unit hai. ϕ = BA se 1 Wb = 1 T × 1 m² = 1 N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ × m² = 1 N m A⁻¹: 1 T field par amoodi 1 m² area se guzarne wala flux.

book_ref.quote: which is called weber (Wb)

blocks.prompt:
20 Why is magnetic induction also called magnetic flux density? Give its units.
(Magnetic induction ko magnetic flux density kyun kehte hain? Is ki units batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke B, B par amoodi surface ka fi unit area flux hai (B = ϕ/A). Is ki units Wb m⁻² hain, jo N A⁻¹ m⁻¹ (tesla) ke barabar hain.

book_ref.quote: According to Eq. 10.5, the magnetic induction B is the flux per unit area

blocks.prompt:
21 A rectangular loop 30 cm × 10 cm is placed in a uniform field of 0.6 T, the field making 60° with the normal to the loop. Find the flux through it.
(30 cm × 10 cm ka rectangular loop 0.6 T ke uniform field mein hai; field loop ke normal se 60° ka angle banata hai. Flux nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For orientation (a), angle between B and area vector A

blocks.prompt:
22 A flux of 4.5 × 10⁻³ Wb passes normally through an area of 150 cm². Find the flux density.
(4.5 × 10⁻³ Wb flux 150 cm² area se amoodan guzarta hai. Flux density nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the magnetic field strength is measured in terms of

blocks.prompt:
23 Define magnetic flux linkage. Write its formula and unit.
(Magnetic flux linkage ki definition, formula aur unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Magnetic flux linkage coil ke aik loop ke flux aur turns ki tadaad ka hasil-e-zarb hai: Φ = Nϕ_B (Eq. 10.7). Yeh batata hai ke coil ke saath kitna flux jura hai. Unit: weber (Wb).

book_ref.quote: Magnetic flux linkage is a key concept in electromagnetism

blocks.prompt:
24 A coil of 150 turns, each of area 0.02 m², is held perpendicular to a uniform field of 0.2 T. Find the flux linkage.
(150 turns wali coil, har turn ka area 0.02 m², 0.2 T ke uniform field par amoodi rakhi hai. Flux linkage nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: and N are the total number of turns of the coil

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between magnetic flux and magnetic flux linkage.
(Magnetic flux aur magnetic flux linkage mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Flux aik loop ka hai; flux linkage coil ke tamam turns ka.

book_ref.quote: is an important factor in understanding how coils and inductors operate

rows: A area ke aik loop se guzarne wala flux.
Aik loop ka flux zarb turns ki tadaad.
Turns ki tadaad par munhasir nahi.
Turns N barhne se barhti hai.

blocks.prompt:
26 How does an ATM card store information?
(ATM card maloomat kaise mehfooz karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ki magnetic strip mein lakhon chhote magnetic domains resin binder se jure hote hain. Machine strip par likhi maloomat parh kar account tak rasai deti hai.

book_ref.quote: The machine reads the information encoded on the magnetic strip

blocks.text: 10.4 Motion of a charged particle in a magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
27 Does a charged particle moving in a magnetic field experience a force? When is this force maximum and when zero?
(Kya magnetic field mein chalte charged particle par force lagti hai? Yeh force kab sab se zyada aur kab sifar hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haan. Tajrubaat batate hain ke magnetic field ke aar paar chalte charged particle par F = qvB sin θ force lagti hai. Jab v, B par amoodi ho (θ = 90°) to sab se zyada aur jab v, B ki seedh mein ho (θ = 0) to sifar.

book_ref.quote: do individual charges moving through a magnetic field also experience a force?

blocks.prompt:
28 N charges, each q, move with speed v along a conductor of length L. Show that the current is I = Nqv/L.
(N charges, har aik q, L lambai ke conductor mein v speed se chal rahe hain. Sabit karein ke current I = Nqv/L hai.)
blocks.explanation: t waqt mein kul charge Q = Nq guzarta hai, is liye I = Q/t = Nq/t. Charges L lambai t = L/v waqt mein tay karte hain. Lehaza I = Nq/(L/v) = Nqv/L (Eq. 10.8).

book_ref.quote: where Q is the total charge flowing in time t

blocks.prompt:
29 How are a positive and a negative charge, entering the same magnetic field with the same velocity, deflected?
(Aik hi magnetic field mein aik hi velocity se daakhil hone wale positive aur negative charge kaise murte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Force ka nishan charge ke nishan par munhasir hai, is liye woh ulti simton mein murte hain. Fig. 10.10 (field kaghaz ke andar) mein positive charge oopar aur negative charge neeche mur kar curved raaste par chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The sign of the force depends on whether the charge q is positive or negative.

blocks.prompt:
30 Why does a charged particle entering a uniform magnetic field at right angles move in a circle? Find the radius of the circle.
(Uniform magnetic field mein amoodan daakhil charged particle daire mein kyun chalta hai? Daire ka radius nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Magnetic force qvB hamesha v par amoodi hai, is liye speed nahi badalti balkay centripetal force milti hai. qvB = mv²/r, is liye r = mv/qB.

book_ref.quote: this force provides centripetal force to the electron to keep it in a circle of radius r

blocks.prompt:
31 A particle of charge 3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C moves at 1 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹ perpendicular to a field of 0.4 T. Find the magnetic force on it.
(3.2 × 10⁻¹⁹ C charge wala particle 0.4 T field par amoodi 1 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Us par magnetic force nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: then magnitude of force F is given by

blocks.prompt:
32 A proton (m = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, q = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) moves at 1 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹ perpendicular to a 0.1 T field. Find the radius of its path.
(Proton (m = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, q = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C) 0.1 T field par amoodi 1 × 10⁵ m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Us ke raaste ka radius nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Putting the values in above equation, we have

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between the magnetic force on a current-carrying conductor and on a moving charged particle.
(Current wale conductor par aur chalte charged particle par magnetic force mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono aik hi qanoon se hain; aik poore current par, doosri aik charge par.

book_ref.quote: Therefore the force on a single particle will be

rows: θ conductor aur B ka angle hai.
θ, v aur B ka angle hai.
Current ke tamam charges par mil kar lagti hai.
Aik charged particle par lagti hai.

blocks.prompt:
34 Can two magnetic field lines cross each other? What does the chapter say?
(Kya do magnetic field lines aik doosre ko kaat sakti hain? Chapter kya kehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Electric field lines ki tarah magnetic field lines kabhi aik doosre ko nahi kaattein; balkay aik doosre se door hatti hain.

book_ref.quote: magnetic field lines also never cross each other but instead push apart of each other

blocks.prompt:
35 In what direction should a charged particle move in a magnetic field so that no magnetic force acts on it?
(Charged particle magnetic field mein kis simt mein chale ke us par koi magnetic force na lage?)
blocks.explanation: Field ki simt mein (ya us ke ulat). Tab θ = 0 (ya 180°), sin θ = 0, is liye F = qvB sin θ = 0.

book_ref.quote: force is zero when B is in the direction of v

blocks.prompt:
36 What is a velocity selector? On what principle does it work?
(Velocity selector kya hai? Yeh kis usool par kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Velocity selector charged particle ki velocity maloom (select) karne ka aala hai. Chalte particle par electric aur magnetic forces ulti simton mein lagti hain aur sirf aik velocity par barabar hoti hain; woh particle seedha mustaqil velocity se chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: they balance each other only for one value of velocity

blocks.prompt:
37 Show that a velocity selector passes particles of speed v = E/B undeflected.
(Sabit karein ke velocity selector v = E/B speed wale particles ko bina mode guzarta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Jab v, E aur B dono par amoodi ho: magnetic force (oopar) = Bqv; electric force (neeche) = qE. Na murne ke liye Bqv = qE, is liye v = E/B (Eq. 10.15).

book_ref.quote: As the velocity v is perpendicular to both B and E, therefore,

blocks.prompt:
38 Why does a particle of the selected speed move with constant velocity through a velocity selector? What happens to other particles?
(Chuni hui speed wala particle velocity selector mein mustaqil velocity se kyun chalta hai? Baqi particles ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electric aur magnetic forces aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain, net force sifar hai, is liye Newton ke pehle qanoon se velocity mustaqil rehti hai aur woh daayen sire se nikalta hai. Doosri velocity wale particles mur jaate hain aur daayen sire se nahi nikalte.

book_ref.quote: As a result, the particle moves in a straight line at a constant velocity

blocks.prompt:
39 In a velocity selector E = 2.4 × 10³ N C⁻¹ and B = 0.12 T. Find the speed of the particles that pass undeflected.
(Velocity selector mein E = 2.4 × 10³ N C⁻¹ aur B = 0.12 T hai. Bina mure guzarne wale particles ki speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Thus, the selected speed is:

blocks.prompt:
40 A particle goes straight through crossed fields E = 2000 N C⁻¹ and B = 0.2 T. When E is switched off, it moves in a circle of radius 2.5 cm. Find q/m.
(Particle E = 2000 N C⁻¹ aur B = 0.2 T ke fields se seedha guzarta hai. E band karne par 2.5 cm radius ke daire mein chalta hai. q/m nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: v = E/B aur Bqv = mv²/r se q/m = E/(B²r) = 2000/(0.04 × 0.025) = 2 × 10⁶ C kg⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: So, charge to mass ratio becomes, q/m = v/Br

blocks.prompt:
41 Define motional emf. Why does a current flow when the ends of the moving conductor are joined?
(Motional emf ki definition likhein. Chalte conductor ke sire jorne par current kyun behta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnetic field ke aar paar conductor ki harkat se paida emf motional emf kehlati hai. Yeh battery ki tarah kaam karti hai, is liye siron ko taar se jor kar band circuit banane par current behta hai.

book_ref.quote: an electromotive force (emf) is induced between its ends

blocks.prompt:
42 Explain how an electric field E = vB is set up inside a rod moving with speed v perpendicular to a field B.
(B par amoodi v speed se chalti rod ke andar electric field E = vB kaise banta hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Rod ke charges par rod ki seedh mein F = qvB lagti hai aur woh sire b par jama hote hain, a par kami hoti hai. Is se b se a ki taraf electrostatic field E banta hai. Jab qE = qvB ho jaye to equilibrium, yani E = vB (Eq. 10.17).

book_ref.quote: As more charges move, a concentration of charge builds up at the top end b

blocks.prompt:
43 Show that the magnitude of motional emf is ε = vBL.
(Sabit karein ke motional emf ki magnitude ε = vBL hai.)
blocks.explanation: Equilibrium mein E = vB. Electric intensity potential gradient ka manfi hai: E = -ΔV/L, is liye ΔV = -LE = -LvB. Lehaza ε = ΔV = -vBL, jis ki magnitude vBL hai (Eq. 10.19); θ angle par ε = -vBL sin θ.

book_ref.quote: The gradient of potential is given by

blocks.prompt:
44 A 60 cm rod moves at 5 m s⁻¹ perpendicular to a uniform field of 0.3 T. Find the emf induced across its ends.
(60 cm ki rod 0.3 T ke uniform field par amoodi 5 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai. Us ke siron par induced emf nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: This is the magnitude of motional emf. However

blocks.prompt:
45 A 30 cm rod moves at 10 m s⁻¹ in a 0.2 T field, its velocity making 45° with the field. Find the magnitude of the induced emf.
(30 cm ki rod 0.2 T field mein 10 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai, velocity field se 45° par hai. Induced emf ki magnitude nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: However, if the angle between v and B is

blocks.prompt:
46 When current flows through the loop, the charge at end b decreases. Why does the current still continue?
(Loop mein current behne se sire b par charge kam hota hai. Phir bhi current kyun jaari rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oopar charge kam hone se electric field kam hota hai magar magnetic force wahi rehti hai. Ghair mutawazan magnetic force sire a tak pohanchne wale charges ko wapas b tak le jati hai, is liye rod chalne tak current jaari rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: they are carried back to the top end b by the unbalanced magnetic field

blocks.prompt:
47 On what principle does wireless charging work?
(Wireless charging kis usool par kaam karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wireless charging electromagnetic induction ke usool par kaam karti hai, yani wohi usool jis se badalta magnetic flux coil mein emf induce karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Wireless charging works under the principle

blocks.prompt:
48 State Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction and write its mathematical form.
(Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon bayan karein aur us ki riyazi shakal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: N loops wali conducting coil mein average induced emf, coil se guzarne wale magnetic flux ki waqt ke saath tabdeeli ki sharah ke manfi ke barabar hai: ε = -N Δϕ/Δt (Eq. 10.24).

book_ref.quote: This conclusion was first arrived at by Faraday

blocks.prompt:
49 Starting from ε = -vBL, show that ε = -Δϕ/Δt for a single loop.
(ε = -vBL se shuru kar ke sabit karein ke aik loop ke liye ε = -Δϕ/Δt.)
blocks.explanation: v = Δx/Δt rakhne se ε = -(Δx/Δt)BL. Δt waqt mein loop ka area ΔA = ΔxL barhta hai, is liye flux Δϕ = (ΔA)B = ΔxLB barhta hai. Lehaza ε = -Δϕ/Δt (Eq. 10.23).

book_ref.quote: This increases the flux through the loop by

blocks.prompt:
50 What is the significance of the minus sign in Faraday's law?
(Faraday ke qanoon mein manfi nishan ki kya ahmiyat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Manfi nishan batata hai ke induced emf ki simt aisi hoti hai ke woh us flux ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne use paida kiya (yahi Lenz ka qanoon hai).

book_ref.quote: The minus sign indicates that the direction of the induced emf

blocks.prompt:
51 The flux through each turn of a 250-turn coil changes by 6 × 10⁻⁴ Wb in 0.05 s. Find the magnitude of the average induced emf.
(250 turns wali coil ke har turn ka flux 0.05 s mein 6 × 10⁻⁴ Wb badalta hai. Average induced emf ki magnitude nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: then the induced emf will become N times

blocks.text: 10.7 Lenz's law and direction of induced emf

blocks.prompt:
52 State Lenz's law. Who discovered it and when?
(Lenz ka qanoon bayan karein. Yeh kis ne aur kab dariyaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Induced current ki simt hamesha aisi hoti hai ke woh us tabdeeli ki mukhalifat kare jis ne current paida kiya. Yeh Heinrich Lenz ki 1834 ki dariyaft par mabni hai.

book_ref.quote: He found that the polarity of an induced emf always produces an induced current

blocks.prompt:
53 A north pole of a bar magnet is pushed towards a coil. Use Lenz's law to find the polarity of the near face of the coil and the direction of the current.
(Bar magnet ka north pole coil ki taraf dhakela jata hai. Lenz ke qanoon se coil ke qareebi rukh ki polarity aur current ki simt batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dhakkay ki mukhalifat ke liye coil ka qareebi rukh north pole ban jata hai aur do north poles aik doosre ko dhakelte hain. Right-hand rule se magnet ki taraf se dekhne par current anticlockwise hai. Magnet door kheenchne par qareebi rukh south pole ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This arrangement causes the two north poles to repel each other.

blocks.prompt:
54 How is Lenz's law consistent with the law of conservation of energy?
(Lenz ka qanoon conservation of energy ke qanoon se kaise mutabiqat rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chalti rod ka induced current v ke ulat magnetic force F_m paida karta hai jo rod ko rokti hai. Rod chalane ke liye F_m ke barabar aur ulat bahar ki force lagani parti hai; isi ka kaam electrical energy deta hai. Koi energy khud nahi banti.

book_ref.quote: This external force provides the energy necessary for the induced current to flow.

blocks.prompt:
55 Why does Lenz's law forbid a clockwise induced current in the rod-and-rails experiment (Fig. 10.16-b)?
(Rod aur rails wale tajrube (Fig. 10.16-b) mein Lenz ka qanoon clockwise induced current ki ijazat kyun nahi deta?)
blocks.explanation: Clockwise current se F_m, v ki taraf hoti aur rod tez hoti. Is se current aur force mazeed barhte aur rod mazeed tez hoti: be-wajah barhti kinetic energy, jo conservation of energy ke khilaf hai.

book_ref.quote: Starting with a minute quantity of energy, we obtain an ever-increasing kinetic energy

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: induced current hamesha harkat ki mukhalifat karta hai. Agar madad karta to rod khud ba khud tez hoti jati aur energy muft mein milti, jo mumkin nahi.

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
58 A 40 cm rod carries an induced current of 1.5 A while sliding at right angles to a 0.5 T field. What external force keeps it moving at constant velocity?
(40 cm ki rod mein 1.5 A induced current hai aur woh 0.5 T field par amoodi phisal rahi hai. Use mustaqil velocity se chalane ke liye kitni bahar ki force chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: F_m = ILB sin 90° = 1.5 × 0.40 × 0.5 = 0.3 N, v ke ulat. Is liye v ki simt mein 0.3 N bahar ki force chahiye.

book_ref.quote: an external force equal in magnitude to F_m but opposite in direction must be applied

(Induced emf ki magnitude par asar karne wale awamil (factors) ke naam likhein.)

blocks.prompt:
61 A coil of 100 turns gives an emf of 0.4 V for a certain rate of change of flux. What emf will a 300-turn coil give for the same rate?
(100 turns wali coil flux ki kisi sharah par 0.4 V emf deti hai. Usi sharah par 300 turns wali coil kitni emf degi?)
blocks.explanation: Emf turns ke tanasub mein hai: ε₂ = ε₁ × N₂/N₁ = 0.4 × 300/100 = 1.2 V.

book_ref.quote: induced emf is also proportional to the number of turns of the coil

blocks.prompt:
62 What is a ferrofluid? What is it made of?
(Ferrofluid kya hai? Yeh kis cheez se bana hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ferrofluid aisa maadda hai jis mein liquid aur magnetic dono khususiyaat hain. Yeh carrier fluid (oil ya paani) mein magnetic particles (aam tor par iron oxide, taqreeban 10 nm) ka colloidal suspension hai; particles par surfactant ki teh hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It operates through a combination of magnetic and fluid dynamics principles.

blocks.prompt:
63 Why do the particles of a ferrofluid neither clump together nor settle down?
(Ferrofluid ke particles na aapas mein chipakte hain na neeche baithte hain, kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Surfactant ki teh (jo surface tension kam karti hai) chipakne se rokti hai aur unhein barabar phailaye rakhti hai. Fluid ki viscosity, particles ka nanometre size aur musalsal harkat unhein baithne nahi deti.

book_ref.quote: This coating prevents the particles from clumping together

blocks.prompt:
64 How does a ferrofluid behave with and without a magnet nearby?
(Magnet ke qareeb hone aur na hone par ferrofluid ka rawaiya kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnet ke baghair yeh liquid ki tarah hai. Magnet qareeb ho to particles aarzi tor par magnetize ho kar structures banate hain aur fluid solid jaisa ho jata hai. Magnet hatane par particles demagnetize ho jaate hain aur yeh phir liquid ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: When there is no magnet around, a ferrofluid acts like a liquid

blocks.prompt:
65 What are the spikes of a ferrofluid and why do they form?
(Ferrofluid ki spikes kya hain aur kyun banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Taaqatwar field mein magnetic forces fluid ko oopar kheenchti hain jab ke gravity aur surface tension neeche. Field lines ke saath zanjeer jaise structures bante hain aur viscosity barhti hai; jahan magnetic forces jeet jaayein wahan solid jaise ubhaar (spikes) bante hain.

book_ref.quote: These are commonly known as spikes.

blocks.prompt:
66 Give two uses of ferrofluids in electronics and loudspeakers.
(Electronics aur loudspeakers mein ferrofluids ke do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Computer hard drives aur ghoomne wale shaft motors ki rotary seals. (2) Loudspeakers mein magnetic field inhein voice coil ke gird rakhta hai; yeh coil ki heat jazb kar ke kharij karte hain aur vibrations kam kar ke awaaz behtar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: There are many applications of ferrofluids in the fields of electronics

blocks.prompt:
67 How are ferrofluids used in medicine?
(Medicine mein ferrofluids kaise istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bahar ke magnets ki madad se ferrofluid ke particles dawa ko seedha tumour ya kisi target tak le jaate hain (targeted drug delivery), jis se side effects kam hote hain. Yeh MRI mein contrast agent bhi hain.

book_ref.quote: Ferrofluids can also be used as contrast agents in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

blocks.prompt:
68 How can a simple ferrofluid be made in the laboratory? What is seen when a magnet is brought near it?
(Lab mein saada ferrofluid kaise banaya ja sakta hai? Magnet qareeb lane par kya nazar aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Test tube mein laser printer toner (taqreeban 40 % nanometre iron oxide) aur cooking oil mila kar bottle mein dalein. Magnet qareeb lane par fluid us ki taraf uchhalta hai kyunke khud magnet ban jata hai; side par magnet rakhne se spikes banti hain.

book_ref.quote: Add some cooking oil in it and mix it well with the stick to form ferrofluid.

blocks.prompt:
69 What is a seismometer? On what principle does it work?
(Seismometer kya hai? Yeh kis usool par kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Seismometer aisa aala hai jo zameen ke neeche chattanon ki harkat ya zalzalon, aatish fishan aur dhamakon ki vibrations ko mehsoos karta hai. Yeh Faraday ke electromagnetic induction ke qanoon par kaam karta hai aur zameen ki harkat ko electrical signals mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: A seismometer is an instrument that responds to any movement of the rocks under the ground

blocks.prompt:
70 Explain how an emf is induced in a seismometer during an earthquake.
(Zalzale ke dauraan seismometer mein emf kaise induce hoti hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Spring se latka wazan coil ke andar magnet se jura hota hai. Zameen hilne par wazan inertia ki wajah se ruka rehta hai, is liye magnet aur coil mein relative harkat hoti hai. Coil ka badalta flux emf aur current induce karta hai jo zameen ki velocity ke tanasub mein hai.

book_ref.quote: This results in relative motion between the weight and the frame of the seismometer

blocks.prompt:
71 What information about an earthquake is obtained from a seismometer?
(Seismometer se zalzale ke baare mein kya maloomat milti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amplify aur record kiye gaye signals zalzale ki waves ka amplitude, frequency aur duration dete hain. In ke tajziye se zalzale ki location, magnitude aur depth maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The data is analyzed to determine various characteristics of the earthquake

blocks.prompt:
72 Where and how is a seismometer installed?
(Seismometer kahan aur kaise lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh aam tor par zameen mein 50-1000 m gehrai par aik hifazati dabbe (vault) mein dabaya jata hai: taqreeban 1 m chaura aur 2 m gehra cylindrical steel tank jis ke neeche concrete pad hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Usually, a seismometer is buried under the ground at a depth of 50-1000 metres.

blocks.prompt:
73 Differentiate between P-waves and S-waves of an earthquake.
(Zalzale ki P-waves aur S-waves mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh seismic waves ki do bari qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: S-waves are secondary waves which are transverse in nature
